# Keys

SUPER is the Windows key. `SUPER+/` shows this list on screen; `fui keys --text` prints it.

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `` SUPER+Return `` | terminal |
| `` SUPER+SHIFT+Return `` | the startup terminal tabs |
| `` SUPER+` `` | dropdown terminal |
| `` SUPER+D `` | apps |
| `` SUPER+Space `` | command palette |
| `` SUPER+/ `` | this list of keys |
| `` SUPER+B `` | browser |
| `` SUPER+E `` | file manager |
| `` SUPER+Y `` | files in the terminal |
| `` SUPER+A `` | audio mixer |
| `` SUPER+SHIFT+N `` | network |
| `` SUPER+N `` | notifications and control centre |
| `` SUPER+. `` | emoji |
| `` SUPER+SHIFT+V `` | clipboard history |
| `` SUPER+Q `` | close window |
| `` SUPER+F `` | fullscreen |
| `` SUPER+V `` | float / tile |
| `` SUPER+P `` | pseudotile |
| `` SUPER+J `` | split direction |
| `` SUPER+G `` | group windows as tabs |
| `` SUPER+Tab `` | next tab in the group |
| `` SUPER+SHIFT+Tab `` | previous tab in the group |
| `` SUPER+Escape `` | lock |
| `` SUPER+X `` | power menu |
| `` SUPER+SHIFT+E `` | quit Hyprland |
| `` SUPER+SHIFT+T `` | theme: night → concrete → lab |
| `` SUPER+SHIFT+W `` | live / still backdrop |
| `` SUPER+SHIFT+C `` | screen finish (vignette) on / off |
| `` SUPER+R `` | screen recording start / stop |
| `` Print `` | screenshot a region (copied and saved) |
| `` SHIFT+Print `` | screenshot the screen |
| `` SUPER+Print `` | screenshot a region and annotate it |
| `` SUPER+arrows `` | focus the window in that direction |
| `` SUPER+SHIFT+arrows `` | move the window in that direction |
| `` SUPER+1..9 `` | go to workspace |
| `` SUPER+SHIFT+1..9 `` | send the window to workspace |
| `` SUPER+drag `` | move a window (left button) or resize it (right button) |
| `` XF86AudioRaiseVolume `` | output-volume raise" .. tick), { locked = true, repeating = true }) |
| `` XF86AudioLowerVolume `` | output-volume lower" .. tick), { locked = true, repeating = true }) |
| `` XF86AudioMute `` | output-volume mute-toggle"), { locked = true }) |
| `` XF86AudioMicMute `` | input-volume mute-toggle"), { locked = true }) |
| `` XF86MonBrightnessUp `` | brightness raise"), { locked = true, repeating = true }) |
| `` XF86MonBrightnessDown `` | brightness lower"), { locked = true, repeating = true }) |
| `` volume / brightness / media keys `` | shown on screen by swayosd |
